## ✅ Pre-Merge Validation

**Automated Checks** (must pass):

- [ ] All tests compile without errors
- [ ] All tests pass (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Coverage threshold met (≥70%)
- [ ] TypeScript type-check passes
- [ ] Linting passes

---

## 👥 Human Review Checklist

**Required for ALL AI-generated tests**:

### 1. Correctness

- [ ] Tests compile without TypeScript errors
- [ ] All tests pass when executed
- [ ] No flaky tests (run multiple times to verify)

### 2. Requirements Alignment

- [ ] Test names follow "Property X.Y" convention
- [ ] Assertions match requirements from design.md
- [ ] All specified properties are covered
- [ ] Edge cases are tested (null, empty, boundary values)

### 3. Test Quality

- [ ] Property invariants are correctly specified
- [ ] Mock setup is appropriate
- [ ] No duplicate tests
- [ ] Tests are deterministic (no random values, Date.now())
- [ ] Test data is meaningful (not "foo", "bar", "test")

### 4. Code Quality

- [ ] Imports are correct and organized
- [ ] No unused imports or variables
- [ ] Follows existing test patterns in codebase
- [ ] Comments explain non-obvious test logic

### 5. Coverage

- [ ] Critical paths have adequate tests
- [ ] Authorization/authentication tested
- [ ] Tenant isolation verified (if applicable)
- [ ] Error cases covered
